scientific_integrity: Exact cyclic-chord formulas and analytic renewal-reward proof; checker is finite corroboration only. Claims have not undergone independent mathematical review.
scientific_limitations: Fixed independent vertex retention p in (0,1), radius-one regular polygons, N tending to infinity; weak limits and asymptotic covariances only; no uniformity at p endpoints; equivalence to unindexed literature not ruled out.
title: Two-scale Gaussian geometry of Bernoulli-thinned regular polygons
